messages:
Lina (Design): Quick sync — small multiples sparklines review. Proposal: show a faint median dot + optional median dashed line on hover, keep smoothing but make it off by default in compact mode. Also propose legend copy change from 'avg' → 'median' for clarity. Outlier handling: replace giant spike overlays with an outlier pill (+3σ) to avoid vertical squeeze. Screenshot attached (mock).

Rory (Eng): +1 on median marker. Implementation note: median can be computed client-side from visible window; we should avoid full-series compute on render. For spike-pill, idea: compute percentile window and if spike > X*IQR replace line segment with pill. Pseudocode:
```
if spike > threshold:
  renderPill(pos)
else:
  renderLineSegment()
```

Devin (Product): copy nit: in legend prefer 'Median' vs 'Avg (mean)'. Users will interpret 'avg' as mean. Also propose 'Show smoothing' toggle persisted per route. Tied to Optimize metrics.

Priya (Accessibility): A11y notes: median marker must be 3:1 contrast at small sizes; provide keyboard focus target and aria-label like 'Median: 42 ms'. For pill, ensure tooltip accessible via focus and has role='tooltip'. Avoid color-only encoding—add pattern or shape for median marker.

Lina (Design): Good points. @Rory can you prototype the hover dashed line + median dot? @Priya will review with screenreader. I'll update Figma and swap legend copy. One question: when compact (sparkline) mode, should we move the unit into tooltip only? My feeling: keep minimal suffix on axis (e.g., 'ms') and full unit in tooltip.

Rory (Eng): Sounds fine. For compact we can collapse axis labels to suffix only and add tooltip detail. Implementation checklist:
- median compute (O(n) offline or cached per dataset)
- spike detection threshold config
- legend entry: 'Median' text
- keyboard/hover focus states

design-bot: Mock updated in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123/sparklines-median (preview)

Lina (Design): I'll push updates by EOD. If anyone has strong objections call them out now, else I'll proceed. :thumbsup:
